logo.description: Wordmark 'COTTON WORLD' stacked in two lines beside a small leaf/plant mark, rendered in the site header on a light background. Tagline used in hero imagery: 'The Natural Clothing Co. | Est. 1987'. A canonical standalone logo asset URL was not confirmed from the public crawl.

business_description: Cottonworld is an Indian apparel brand (Est. 1987) selling clothing made from natural fabrics — cotton, linen, and bamboo — for men and women. The range spans top wear (t-shirts, shirts, kurtas, jackets, tops, vests), bottom wear (pants, shorts, skirts, leggings, culottes), dresses/jumpsuits, lounge wear, sleep wear, and co-ords, organized by fabric and by occasion collections (Work, Travel, Brunch, Summer, Bestsellers). Positioning centers on comfortable, breathable, climate-appropriate, long-lasting natural clothing — 'Made with care. Worn for years.' Sold online at cottonworld.net (Shopify) and through physical retail stores across India (omnichannel).
business_model: B2C direct-to-consumer apparel retail (omnichannel: e-commerce + physical stores across India). Shopify storefront. Revenue from single-item and multi-item apparel purchases; promotions/sitewide sales (e.g. 'Go Green Sale – up to 50% off') are a recurring lever.

brand_colors.brand_accent: Natural green (leaf mark; 'Go Green' sustainability framing)
brand_colors.supporting: Earthy, muted, natural tones drawn from product photography (olive, beige, white, natural linen)

brand_aesthetic: Warm, natural, lifestyle-led fashion e-commerce aesthetic. Editorial hero photography of models in natural outdoor settings, muted earthy palette, large product grids, occasion- and fabric-based merchandising. Communicates comfort, sustainability, and everyday timeless style rather than fast-fashion trend churn.

brand_voice.description: Warm, reassuring, and value-led. Emphasizes comfort, natural materials, care, and longevity over hype or discounts-first messaging. Plain, human sentences ('Made with care. Worn for years.', 'Because the best clothing isn't worn once. It's worn often.'). Sustainability and heritage (Est. 1987) are recurring proof points.
voice_patterns: Comfort- and fabric-first claims ('natural materials that feel comfortable, breathe well, age beautifully')
Longevity and care framing over trend/newness

brand_values: Natural materials first — cotton, linen, and bamboo chosen for comfort, breathability, and India's climate.
Longevity over disposability — 'Worn for years'; clothing meant to age well and be worn often.
Comfort and everyday wearability as the core product promise.
Sustainability framing — natural fabrics and 'Go Green' positioning.
Heritage and trust — an established Indian clothing company since 1987 with omnichannel retail.

primary: Indian men and women seeking comfortable, natural-fabric everyday clothing (cotton/linen/bamboo).
Value-conscious but quality-oriented shoppers who prefer breathable, climate-appropriate, long-lasting apparel over fast fashion.
roles: Working professionals dressing for work, travel, and weekends
Repeat/loyal customers of an established heritage brand
